content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user viewing the task report","i_want":"to filter, search and sort the tasks shown in the report","so_that":"I can find the specific tasks I need in the report","business_description":"The Task Reporting page lists the user's tasks. Users can narrow the list by Status, Priority and Date Range, search tasks by title, and sort the list by Creation Date, Due Date, Status or Priority. The backend supplies the filtered, searched and sorted task data for the page.","business_value":"Users can locate specific tasks in the report without scanning the whole table, which supports review of their own task list.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The report contains tasks with Status Open and tasks with Status Completed","when":"The user selects Status Open in the Status filter","then":"Only tasks with Status Open are listed in the report table"},{"given":"The report contains tasks with Priority Low, Medium and High","when":"The user selects Priority High in the Priority filter","then":"Only tasks with Priority High are listed in the report table"},{"given":"The report contains tasks with different dates","when":"The user sets a Date Range in the Date Range filter","then":"Only tasks whose date falls inside the selected range are listed in the report table"},{"given":"The report contains tasks with titles 'Pay invoice' and 'Write report'","when":"The user types 'invoice' in the title search","then":"Only the task titled 'Pay invoice' is listed in the report table"},{"given":"The report table lists several tasks","when":"The user selects the Due Date column to sort the table","then":"The tasks are listed in Due Date order"},{"given":"The report table lists several tasks","when":"The user selects Creation Date, Status or Priority as the sort field","then":"The tasks are listed in the order of the selected field"},{"given":"A filter, a title search and a sort are applied on the report page","when":"The report data is requested from the backend","then":"The backend returns only the tasks matching the filter and search, in the requested sort order"}],"edge_cases":["The PRD does not state which task date (Creation Date or Due Date) the Date Range filter applies to; this is an open question.","The PRD does not state how multiple filters combine (for example, Status and Priority together); this is an open question.","The PRD does not state the sort direction (ascending or descending) or the default sort order; this is an open question.","The PRD does not state where tasks with an empty Due Date or a Completion Date that is not set are placed when sorting; this is an open question.","A title search that matches no tasks returns an empty result; the wording of any message shown in this case is not specified.","Title search matching (case sensitivity, partial words, leading or trailing spaces) is not specified; this is an open question."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-report"],"definition_of_done":["The report page provides controls to filter by Status, Priority and Date Range.","The report page provides a title search field.","The report table can be sorted by Creation Date, Due Date, Status and Priority.","The report query endpoint accepts filter, title search and sort parameters and returns the matching tasks in the requested order.","Metric totals (Total Tasks, Open Tasks, Completed Tasks) are not changed by this story.","Invalid filter or sort values return an error response handled by the standard error handling approach.","Automated tests cover each filter, the title search, each sort field and the combined request.","The open questions listed in the edge cases are answered and recorded in the story before release."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"report-query-filter-search-sort-api","title":"[BE] Add filter, title search and sort parameters to the task report query endpoint","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Extend the endpoint that returns tasks for the report so it accepts Status, Priority and Date Range filters, a title search term, and a sort field (Creation Date, Due Date, Status or Priority). Return only matching tasks in the requested order. Reject invalid parameter values with the standard error response.
